rationale: Manual comparison confirms that g-mamṭe ḥurma sawto through bas ḥamšo=daqayəq belongs to 83/55, w-mbal hay mo=dinore dahwo w-haw-la-nne to 83/56, and g-əzzayo i=ḥurm-aṯe ... gə-mṭabqo-la w-k-ṭəryo əṯyo to 83/57. The example combines three consecutive verses. The automatic not-found result is not evidence that verse 57 is absent; that verse contains the final part.
